headline: Hungarian Listed Firms Weigh Exit Over Socialist Wealth Tax Proposals
summary: The supervisory board of Budapest-listed Goodwill Pharma warned that multiple exchange-listed companies are reviewing their presence on the Budapest Stock Exchange due to proposed government wealth taxes.
why: Unpredictable corporate tax burdens and wealth levies risk prompting capital flight and delistings from Central European equity bourses.

impacts.name: Hungary Equities
impacts.why: Threatened delistings by listed firms undermine market liquidity and investor confidence on the Budapest bourse.
